name: Strings
author: Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner) / packaged for DAW
attribution: VS Chamber Orchestra: Community Edition (VSCO-2 CE) by Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner, Simon Dalzell; sample cutting by Elan Hickler/Soundemote). CC0 1.0.
desc: Violin section ensemble, sustained arco with vibrato, 2 velocity layers, stereo, looped. MIDI 52-90 (best 55-88). Soft high pads, sustained chords, lush melodies. | Playable MIDI 52-90 (E3-F#6), 2 velocity layers crossfaded. Params: human 0-1 (timing/level/pitch life), velcurve (velocity response), keytrack/bright (tone follows pitch/velocity). Articulations: params.artic 0=arco (sustain), 1=staccato, 2=pizzicato, 3=tremolo, 4=marcato (accented); load presets "Pizzicato"/"Staccato"/"Tremolo"/"Marcato".
